decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a sharp cross-axis shift in E/U around indices 485–544 with unclear return, and (2) a prolonged, complex trend in E/U from 605 onward featuring ambiguous superposed changes and possible opposing returns.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample shift in E and U around index 490–495, with E rising sharply from ~1 to >2 and U dropping from ~-0.6 to <-2, while N remains relatively stable; possible opposing return or platform not clearly resolved due to coarse sampling.

Strong sustained upward trend in E (from ~60 to >66) and U (from ~-16 to ~-17.7) beginning near index 630, with intermittent reversals and plateaus; ambiguous superposed changes including abrupt multi-sample drops in E at indices ~650 and ~670 without clear counterpart in N/U.
